purpose: Isolate, using unchanged original native eight-node q0 source/receiver 0.25 s PFFDTD outputs, contributions of fixed physical-time record segments to signed 40/80 Hz spatial adjacent error. No new solver wave run, source alteration, posthoc frequency gate, or acceptance promotion.

original_pffdtd.temporal_source: original eight-node trilinear, unit discrete volume velocity impulse q[0]=1 and q[n>0]=0
original_pffdtd.pressure_conversion: original p=rho*d(phi)/dt centered interior and second-order one-sided endpoints

window.rule: half-open, include n with left native sample timestamp t=n*Ts in [start,end); every n in exactly one segment
window.signed_DFT: exp(+i2pi*f*n*Ts) times raw physical pressure sample; no window taper; source Q_T=Ts exactly, cancels numerator native Ts
window.complex_transfer_component: P_segment(f) / original full-period Q_T(f), with the original full unit q0 source (not segment-local Q)
window.conservation_identity: sum of three signed complex partition contributions reproduces original full finite-record P_T/Q_T at both Hz and each PPW to relative tolerance 1e-10
window.unaltered_full_record: original exact recorded 40/80 Hz controls must match freshly recomputed native full finite DTFT per PPW before partitioning

analysis.comparison: For each pair (a,b), D_total=H_a-H_b and D_partition=H_a,partition-H_b,partition; L2 across signed 40,80 Hz and relative ||D_partition||/max(||D_total||,1e-12); no assume ratios sum 1 due cancellation
